name: Desert Camps & Camel Treks
hero_subtitle: Overnight camps and camel rides toward the dunes — the classic Zagora desert experience.

overview.title: Sand, tea and stars
overview.p1: From Zagora you can arrange camel treks and nights in desert camps — the experience many travellers come south for. Options range from a short sunset ride to a full overnight with dinner and sunrise.
overview.p2: Quality varies: ask what is included, how far the camp sits from town, and whether toilets and bedding match your expectations. Winter nights are cold; summer days are extreme.
overview.p3: Book through a trusted hotel or operator, agree the price in advance, and treat the desert with the respect heat and isolation demand.

q1.question: How far are the camps?
q1.answer: Varies by operator — from nearby dune edges to longer tracks toward wider ergs.

q2.question: What is included?
q2.answer: Often transport, camel time, dinner, breakfast and basic bedding — confirm in writing.

q3.question: Cold at night?
q3.answer: Yes in winter — bring a warm layer.

q4.question: Toilet facilities?
q4.answer: Range from basic to improved — ask before you book.

q5.question: Can I go without an overnight?
q5.answer: Yes — short camel rides and sunset trips are widely offered.
